title: Controller & harness
summary: The missing layer above skills and agents provides execution state and enforceable controls.

sections.label: Design boundary
sections.text: A prompt can describe a rule. The runtime must enforce permissions, state changes, and budget controls. A skill does not create durable execution or prove successful completion.
